what_microsoft_admin_center_does: An activation request needs AI administrator approval before anyone can create instances of the agent, and publishing to the Agent Store is a separate approval or rejection.
kortix_configuration_surface: Add agents/<name>.md and its agents.<name> block in kortix.yaml in one change request; the agent exists once the request merges.
notes: Creation is a diff a person reviews. Traces to the manifest row in claims.md.

what_microsoft_admin_center_does: Block or unblock an agent for the whole tenant from Agents > All agents; blocking removes it from Copilot, Teams, Outlook and other host products for most agent types.
kortix_configuration_surface: Delete agents/<name>.md and its agents.<name> block in one change request. The grants in that block stop resolving with the file.
notes: No tenant-wide block switch. The removal is a commit, and the commit is the record.

what_microsoft_admin_center_does: User access sets All users, No users or specific users and groups for agents and plugins; activation scopes one agent to named users or groups.
kortix_configuration_surface: agents.<name>.kortix_permissions in kortix.yaml, with per-resource permissions for people and groups.
notes: An omitted grant resolves to none. Traces to the permissions row in claims.md.

what_microsoft_admin_center_does: Assign or unassign the Copilot product per user or group from the billing pages; the default activation template can assign automatically at activation.
kortix_configuration_surface: not supported today
notes: Nothing is metered per agent, so there is no per-agent seat. An agent is a file and a governance block in the repo.

what_microsoft_admin_center_does: Allow, Allow trials only or Do not allow: whether people can buy a Copilot subscription without an administrator approving it.
kortix_configuration_surface: not supported today
notes: There is no member-facing purchase path. Billing sits with the account and access is a project grant, so the row is a compensating control in your own notes.

what_microsoft_admin_center_does: Copilot Frontier: No access by default, all groups, or specific groups, covering preview features in the apps and in agents built by Microsoft.
kortix_configuration_surface: not supported today
notes: No tenant preview programme to grant. Experimental features sit behind per-project flags, and a flag is not an entitlement you give a group.

what_microsoft_admin_center_does: Sensitivity labels, DLP policies and SharePoint access controls decide what Copilot can ground on, and Purview DSPM reports where oversharing puts data in reach.
kortix_configuration_surface: agents.<name>.connectors and agents.<name>.secrets in kortix.yaml, plus the policy on each connector action.
notes: Deny by default, so the reviewed file states which data an agent can reach.

what_microsoft_admin_center_does: Agent and plugin access allows or blocks agents and plugins built by Microsoft, by your organisation, or by external publishers; plugins cover tools, MCP servers and connectors.
kortix_configuration_surface: connectors: and tools: on the agents.<name> block, and the policy on each connector action (always_run, require_approval, block).
notes: Traces to the connector policy row in claims.md.

what_microsoft_admin_center_does: Cowork shows each step as it works and you approve each action before it happens.
kortix_configuration_surface: policy: default_mode in the project manifest, and a policy on each connector action. Gates are off until you set them.
notes: default_mode falls back to allow_all when unset, so an empty policy block is the finding. Traces to the approval gates row in claims.md.

what_microsoft_admin_center_does: Prompts, responses, referenced files and admin operations land in Purview Audit, 180 days by default and longer with an audit retention policy.
kortix_configuration_surface: The project audit log, with every action recorded and its plan qualifier, plus the per-session view on the Enterprise plan.
notes: Reading, exporting and streaming depend on the plan. Traces to the audit row in claims.md.

what_microsoft_admin_center_does: The admin center holds no secret store. An agent's credentials sit in its Copilot Studio connections or an Entra app registration, and an administrator consents to the permissions.
kortix_configuration_surface: env.required and env.optional in kortix.yaml name the secrets. Values are set in the Kortix Secrets Manager and never committed.
notes: Grep the repo for the value. The file should hold the name only. Traces to the secrets row in claims.md.

what_microsoft_admin_center_does: AI providers for other large language models allows other models in Copilot Chat and Copilot Studio across the tenant; the admin center does not pick a model per agent.
kortix_configuration_surface: The model key in the frontmatter of agents/<name>.md, per agent, with any provider on your own keys.
notes: A model change is a line in the reviewed agent file. Traces to the models row in claims.md.

what_microsoft_admin_center_does: Copilot operates within the Microsoft 365 service boundary, and a Copilot Studio agent lives in an environment created in a chosen support data region.
kortix_configuration_surface: sandbox.templates and agents.<name>.sandbox in kortix.yaml pin the image, cpu, memory and disk a session boots; the instance runs on Kortix Cloud, in your VPC or on your own network.
notes: The image is a line in the file and the deployment is a review decision. Traces to the hosting row in claims.md.

what_microsoft_admin_center_does: Outputs land in the person's OneDrive, SharePoint and Copilot Pages containers, so they inherit existing file permissions and the highest applied label.
kortix_configuration_surface: The workspace: grant on the agents.<name> block, per-resource permissions, and the change request that gates the merge.
notes: A session's output is not on the default branch until a person merges it. Traces to the permissions row in claims.md.

what_microsoft_admin_center_does: Delete soft-deletes an agent for 30 days, with restore or permanent delete inside the window, and the events are written to the audit log.
kortix_configuration_surface: Delete agents/<name>.md and its agents.<name> block in one change request; git log keeps the earlier definition and the review that produced it.
notes: Recovery is the git history rather than a 30-day window.

what_microsoft_admin_center_does: Export to Excel writes the agent list to a file, and the agent's instructions are one of more than 30 fields you can include.
kortix_configuration_surface: The instructions are agents/<name>.md in the repo, and git show prints the version that ran on a given day.
notes: There is no export step to schedule or to lose.

what_microsoft_admin_center_does: Administrator actions apply at once. Purview records them, including UpdateTenantSettings, CreatePlugin and DeletePlugin, and the admin center has no change request.
kortix_configuration_surface: A change request against the default branch, with merge default-deny for agents unless an administrator granted project.gitops.merge.
notes: The review record and the configuration are the same object. Traces to the path-to-main row in claims.md.

what_microsoft_admin_center_does: Copilot Studio agents live in Power Platform environments: a default environment on first sign-in, and trial or production types, each created in a region.
kortix_configuration_surface: One project, one repository, one kortix.yaml: the same change is reviewed as a diff in a test project before it lands in the production project.
notes: The separation is the repository and project boundary. There is no staging switch inside a project.

what_microsoft_admin_center_does: Purview Audit holds the prompt, the response, the referenced content and the administrator operations, and eDiscovery or content search pulls the interaction for an investigation.
kortix_configuration_surface: The audit log, the session's own branch, the change request it produced, and kortix sessions digest for what a set of sessions did.
notes: The commit a session pushed is evidence a reviewer can open without a support ticket. Traces to the audit row in claims.md.

what_microsoft_admin_center_does: Block sign-in and remove the user, hand over the mailbox and OneDrive, and place an eDiscovery hold if the data has to survive the departure.
kortix_configuration_surface: SCIM 2.0 directory sync for the removal in the project, plus rotation of any secret whose audience included the person.
notes: Removal does not rewrite history: their commits stay in git log. Traces to the SSO row in claims.md.
